title: cistus clusii var. sedjera
intro: Cistus clusii var. sedjera, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a Mediterranean plant species belonging to the Cistaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues due to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, offering potential health benefits such as wound healing, immune system support, and protection against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Cistus clusii var. sedjera include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can contribute to its wound-healing properties and ability to fight off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
